newsitem.title: USA: Sonat Texas well misses Cotton Valley reef.
newsitem.headline: Sonat Texas well misses Cotton Valley reef.

text.p: Sonat Inc said Monday the J.E. Ryon No. 1 Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef trend exploratory test in the Tri-Cities area of Henderson County, Texas, failed to encounter a reef, and is being evaluated for possible completion in shallower formations.
Sonat has a 59 percent working interest in this well. Other working interest owners are United Meridian Corp, 30 percent; Energen Corp, 9 percent; and MB Exploration, 2 percent.

Based on petrophysical data, the analysis of rock cuttings from the well, and the evaluation of borehole seismic data from the original and sidetrack wellbores, Sonat has concluded that no reef was encountered, it said.

The seismic anomaly that was drilled was not a reef, and its reef-like seismic image was the result of a combination of fracturing and secondary cementation of the Cotton Valley limestone formation over a salt-induced flexure, and the existence of an overlying limestone stringer in the Bossier Shale formation, it explained in a statement. This conclusion has been verified by further seismic modeling.

Sonat also said that because this well did not test a Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef, the results do not change the plans for its exploration program or its view concerning the productive potential for reef drilling in this area.
Additional drilling in this area is scheduled for the fourth quarter of this year, Sonat said.
